quote: The resultant λ max for S, M and L visual pigments (and their weightings f n) were 344 nm (0.16), 481 nm (0.48) and 533 nm (1.25), respectively, which are shown individually and summed in Fig. 5a.
note: Logged in the Syricoris sweep as a measured member of Tortricidae (summer fruit tortrix). Template fit to whole-eye ERG, so the three peaks are model estimates of the pigments; the paper says the whole-eye ERG of dark-adapted moths of all strains peaks around 520 nm.
